data.title: POS App Overview
data.description: What the CloudPOS POS app does, who uses it, how these docs are organised, and the demo story used as the worked example on every page.

children.text: CloudPOS POS is the point-of-sale app that store staff use every day. It runs on Windows desktops, Android and iOS tablets, and phones. One app covers supermarket billing, restaurant counters, waiters, the kitchen, stock, purchases, accounts and reports.

The app is built for shops and restaurants in Saudi Arabia and India. It handles tax-inclusive prices, ZATCA e-invoicing (Saudi Arabia), Arabic and English receipts, and works offline when the internet drops.
